You make out an opened fridge. The fridge contains a yellow bell pepper and a block of cheese. You can make out a closed oven. You see a gleam over in a corner, where you can see a table. The table is massive. Looks like someone's already been here and taken everything off it, though. It would have been so cool if there was stuff on the table. You make out a counter. Why don't you take a picture of it, it'll last longer! The counter is vast. On the counter you can see a raw yellow potato, a red apple and an orange bell pepper. You idly wonder how they came up with the name TextWorld for this place. It's pretty fitting. You can make out a stove. However, the stove, like an empty stove, has nothing on it.

There is a closed frosted-glass door leading south. There is a closed patio door leading west. You don't like doors? Why not try going north, that entranceway is not blocked by one.

There is a carrot, a banana and a raw pork chop on the floor.
